description: Class representing a document picture form.

Copy.description: Copies the current form (copies with the shape if it exists).

Delete.description:
Removes a form and its content.

If keepContent is true, the content is not deleted.

params.description: Specifies if the content will be deleted or not.
params.name: keepContent

returns.description: returns false if form wasn't added to the document.

GetBackgroundColor.description: Returns the background color of the current form.

GetBorderColor.description: Returns the border color of the current form.

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiPictureForm class.

GetFormType.description: Returns a type of the current form.

GetImage.description: Returns an image in the base64 format from the current picture form.

GetInternalId.description: Returns an internal id of the current form.

GetLock.description: Returns the lock state of the current form.

GetParent.description: Returns the parent element (a paragraph or an inline content control) that directly contains the current form.

returns.description: returns null if the form has no parent.

GetPicturePosition.description: Returns the picture position inside the current form.

GetPlaceholderText.description: Returns the placeholder text from the current form.

GetPosInParent.description: Returns the position (index) of the current form within its parent element.

returns.description: returns -1 if the form has no parent.

GetRole.description: Returns the role of the current form.

GetScaleFlag.description: Returns the current scaling condition of the picture form.

GetTag.description: Returns the tag attribute for the current form.

GetText.description: Returns the text from the current form.

GetTextPr.description:
Returns the text properties from the current form.

**Note:**
Used if possible for this type of form.

GetTipText.description: Returns the tip text of the current form.

GetValue.description: Returns the current image of the picture form as a base64 encoded string.

GetWrapperShape.description:
Returns a shape in which the form is placed to control the position and size of the fixed size form frame.

The null value will be returned for the inline forms.

returns.description: returns the shape in which the form is placed.

IsFilled.description: Checks if the current form is filled.

IsFixed.description: Checks if the current form is fixed size.

IsLockAspectRatio.description: Checks if the aspect ratio of the current picture form is locked or not.

IsRequired.description: Checks if the current form is required.

IsRespectBorders.description: Checks if the form border width is respected or not.

MoveCursorOutside.description: Places a cursor before/after the current form.

params.description: Specifies whether a cursor will be placed before (false) or after (true) the current form.
params.name: isAfter

SetBackgroundColor.description: Sets the background color to the current form.

params.description: The background color.
params.name: color

SetBorderColor.description: Sets the border color to the current form.

params.description: The border color.
params.name: color

SetFormKey.description: Sets a key to the current form.

params.description: Form key.
params.name: sKey

SetImage.description: Sets an image to the current picture form.

params.description: The image source where the image to be inserted should be taken from (currently, only internet URL or base64 encoded images are supported).
params.name: imageSrc

SetLock.description: Sets the lock state of the current form.

params.description: Specifies whether to lock the form (true) or unlock it (false).
params.name: isLock

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.

SetLockAspectRatio.description: Locks the aspect ratio of the current picture form.

params.description: Specifies if the aspect ratio of the current picture form will be locked (true) or not (false).
params.name: isLock

params.description: Horizontal position measured in percent.
params.name: nShiftX

params.description: Vertical position measured in percent.
params.name: nShiftY

SetPlaceholderText.description:
Sets the placeholder text to the current form.

**Note:**
The placeholder text can't be set for checkbox or radio button forms.

params.description: The text that will be set to the current form.
params.name: sText

SetRequired.description: Specifies if the current form should be required.

params.description: Defines if the current form is required (true) or not (false).
params.name: bRequired

SetRespectBorders.description: Respects the form border width when scaling the image.

params.description: Specifies if the form border width will be respected (true) or not (false).
params.name: isRespect

SetRole.description: Sets the role to the current form.

params.description: The role which will be attached to the current form.
params.name: role

SetScaleFlag.description: Sets the scaling condition to the current picture form.

params.description: Picture scaling condition: "always", "never", "tooBig" or "tooSmall".
params.name: sScaleFlag

SetTag.description: Sets the tag attribute to the current form.

params.description: The tag which will be added to the current container.
params.name: tag

SetTextPr.description:
Sets the text properties to the current form.

**Note:**
Used if possible for this type of form.

params.description: The text properties that will be set to the current form.
params.name: textPr

SetTipText.description: Sets the tip text to the current form.

params.description: Tip text.
params.name: sText

SetValue.description: Sets an image to the picture form.

params.description: The image source (URL or base64 encoded image).
params.name: value

ToFixed.description: Converts the current form to a fixed size form.

params.description: The wrapper shape width measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: width

params.description: The wrapper shape height measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: height

params.description: Save position on the page (it can be a little bit slow, because it runs the document calculation).
params.name: keepPosition

ToFixed.signature: ToFixed(width: twips, height: twips, keepPosition?: boolean): boolean

ToInline.description:
Converts the current form to an inline form.

**Note:**
A picture form can't be converted to an inline form, as it's always a fixed-size object.
